notes.title: STARNAUT full release date set & trailer released!
notes.content:
[h2]― A new experience with even more content to explore! ―  [/h2]

Since its initial Early Access release on Steam on February 14, 2024, STARNAUT has evolved 
through roughly 30 updates shaped by player feedback. Now, as part of the larger mythos 
connected to El Shaddai, we are pleased to announce that the full release is ready for launch on 
April 28—coinciding with the 14th Anniversary of El Shaddai!

[previewyoutube=aUFOhH3KmCs;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]Major Changes in the Full Release  [/h2]
Throughout Early Access, we’ve greatly expanded and refined the game by actively incorporating 
feedback from the player community. Here are some new additions players can experience in the 
full release of the game: 

[list]
[*] Stages: 18 → 60 
[*] Weapon Types: 25 → 49  
[*] Helmet Types: 12 → 22+  
[*] Enemy Types: 100 → 400+ 
[*] Lost Data (Added Content): Over 200 new Lost Data have been added.  
[*] Story Chapters: 11 → 53
[/list]


[h2]What is Mythical Concept STARNAUT?  [/h2]
Mythical Concept STARNAUT is a survivor-style action game with roguelike elements. Set in a 
multidimensional universe, players must battle through relentless waves of enemies, upgrade 
their weapons and equipment, and launch rockets to clear each stage. 
Set within the same mythological framework as El Shaddai, the game invites players to uncover 
its connected narrative and rich world interwoven with the El Shaddai mythos. Each playthrough 
takes roughly 30 minutes, offering a variety of different ways to build your character and evolving 
strategies that keep the gameplay experience fresh and rewarding. 
Key Features 
• Create a variety of combat styles by combining 49 unique weapons 
• Experience an evolving combat system as you dodge and strike back against the 
relentless attacks of over 100 different types 
• Enjoy roguelike gameplay that changes with each run for high replayability 
• Discover hidden lore about the sci-fi narrative of the game through collectable Lost Data 
After roughly 30 updates driven by community feedback during its Early Access, STARNAUT is 
ready for release with a massive expansion in content — featuring new weapons, stages, and 
story content for a deeper, more immersive experience.

notes.title: Volunteer Recruitment for "STARNAUT"
notes.content:
Volunteer Recruitment for "STARNAUT"

We are now entering the final phase of checks in preparation for the full release of "STARNAUT."
To ensure the best experience possible, we are recruiting volunteers from our Early Access users to assist us.
---
[b]Recruitment Overview[/b]
Roles Available:

1. Test Player
2. Promotion Support
3. Translation Check

Participation Requirements
　Must own the Early Access version on Steam

Testing Period
　Until the official release date

[hr][/hr]
Responsibilities of Test Players:

　1. Record Gameplay Videos (Mandatory)

You are free to use any recording method, such as your PC’s built-in recording function or your preferred recording software.
Please upload the recorded data to the designated Dropbox folder.
Provide Feedback via a Spreadsheet (Mandatory)


　2. Example feedback items:

Your impressions of the game
Suggestions for the development team
Areas where explanations felt insufficient or improvement ideas

[hr][/hr]
Responsibilities of Promotion Support

　1. Please post the videos recorded by test players on various social media accounts.
　　＊This is a post for the Starnaut account.
　　＊Playing the game itself is not mandatory.

[hr][/hr]
Responsibilities of Translation Check:

　１. Translation Check
       We will share a spreadsheet, so please check the translations there.
　　[b]Target languages: English, Simplified Chinese[/b]
　　＊Playing the game itself is not mandatory.

[hr][/hr]
General Recruitment Period
  Until Monday, February 17, 2025

◆ How to Apply
Please send an email expressing your interest in participating.
Email Address: info_lucifel@elshaddai.jp
Only successful applicants will be notified by email at a later date.

---
◆ Notes
[strike]Save Data Reset Required: To participate in the test, your current save data must be deleted.[/strike]
When participating in the test, please play with new save data. If you save your Early Access version's save data locally, you'll be able to carry it over and continue playing in the full release version.
No Save Data Transfer: As this test uses data from an in-development build, save data cannot be carried over to the official release.
Posting Restrictions: Videos recorded during the test and specific details about the test are prohibited from being shared on social media, reviews, YouTube, or similar platforms.
---

◆ Participant Benefits
Exclusive Access: The opportunity to play the full release version ahead of its official launch!
[b]Your name will be featured in the credits![/b]
Your support will help make "STARNAUT" an even greater experience. We look forward to your participation!

---
Contact Information:
STARNAUT Development Team
Email: info_lucifel@elshaddai.jp
Official Website:: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2508940/_/?l=japanese

notes.title: "Mythos Project STARNAUT" Full Release Confirmed for November 9!
notes.content:
The full release of Mythos Project STARNAUT has been confirmed for November 9, following its early access launch on Steam in February 2024 and around 30 updates driven by user feedback. The content has been significantly enhanced to offer a unique and improved experience. That's exciting news! Let me know if you'd like help preparing any announcements or other details.


[b]Steam[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2508940/_/


[b]Trailer[/b]
https://youtu.be/NYI48EuuGYM?si=Y3MhYW54f5xdnIjG


[h3]Evolution Points of STARNAUT[/h3]
As part of the El Shaddai mythos, STARNAUT introduces an entirely new story. Additionally, the previously separate prequel novel Copiasu will now be included, offering fans a must-see collection of content packed with rich lore.
This makes STARNAUT even more enticing for fans of the mythos. Let me know if you'd like to further elaborate on any aspects or need help with anything else!

[h3]Main Changes in the Full Release[/h3]
[b]Stages: 10 → Over 30 types
Weapons: 24 → Over 48 types
Helmets: 14 → Over 20 types
Enemy Types: 100 → Over 400 types
Lost Data: Over 100 additional entries[/b]

[h3]Game Features[/h3]
STARNAUT is a replayable survivor action game, with each play session lasting about 30 minutes. Ultimately, players will experience a new mythological world deeply connected to El Shaddai.

[h3]Release Date and Special Significance[/h3]
The release date, November 9, is a special day known as "Enoch Day" among El Shaddai fans in Japan. On this day, a new door to the mythological world will open, allowing players to embark on an unprecedented adventure. Look forward to the full release of Star Note, which has been greatly expanded in content!

Note: The full release price will be announced at a later date.

notes.title: About the release of "STARNAUT" full version【2024/6/28】
notes.content:
[b]Thank you so much for playing the EA version of "STARNAUT"![/b]

[h2][b]1, The date of release of the full version of "STARNAUT"[/b][/h2]

We are working hard for making the full version of "STARNAUT" which is currently in EA.
We are aiming to finish the production and release it on [h3][b][u]Summer, 2024![/u][/b][/h3]

In the full version of the game, we are planning to add the following below.
・[u][b]More than 20 additional levels[/b][/u]
・[u][b]New weapons and its new system[/b][/u]
・[u][b]All Lost Data that are unlockable[/b][/u]
・[u][b]Stories to the ending[/b][/u]

Also, the full version of the game will support the bug fix and etc..

[h2][b]2, About renewing the price of the game[/b][/h2]

Because the game will become full version, the price of the game will be renewed.
For now, we have not decided the price but [h3][u][b]we are planning to make sure the price is going to be beneficial for the people who bought EA version of the game.[/b][/u][/h3]
So, it is a good time to buy the EA version of the game right now if you have not bought the game!

[h2][b]3, Starting the new Early Access campaign[/b][/h2]

We are adding following 2 new helmets that are only available in Early Access version of the game!
[h3][b]・Enoch R　6/28 post update～
・Lucifer G　7/5 post update～[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704066/ec525f08d26ffcae5181b01c83d8dfcfb1d8e71a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704066/105646ab59addc4897678572e51b3c35d0412763.png[/img]

[b]"Eanaut"[/b] is also the helmet that is limited only for EA version of the game and these will not be acquirable after the full version of the game, don't miss it!

Thank you again for the love and support for the game!
